_comment: Inventory of the live PoS bridge: the managers, the token predicates, their immutable proxy shells, and the child-token code that many mapped tokens share. Individually mapped tokens are deliberately NOT tracked — only code that is immutable or shared. 'solc' + 'optimizer' + 'evmVersion' are the settings the contract was DEPLOYED with (from its verified metadata on Sourcify/Etherscan), not the repo defaults: this repo spans three different optimizer configurations. Note that 'runs' matters even when the optimizer is disabled — solc still reads it when choosing the function dispatcher, so the proxy shells reproduce only at (enabled=false, runs<=200). 'liveness' guards against the system being re-pointed at a DIFFERENT address: 'target'+'sig'(+'args') is a call whose returned address must still equal this entry's 'address'. Bytecode at a fixed address is immutable, so the bytecode comparison alone can never catch a proxy upgrade — that has already happened here twice (RootChainManager and ERC20Predicate were both re-pointed in Aug 2025). Add it to anything reached through a pointer. 'knownDrift' documents an entry the repo is deliberately AHEAD of chain on: it reports but does not fail, and the verifier flags the exemption as stale if the contract ever starts reproducing again. 'exclude':true entries are documented but skipped. Where the live system runs a source this repo has since moved past, the old source is FROZEN under a legacy/ directory rather than recorded as drift — see contracts/common/legacy/ and contracts/lib/legacy/. Those files are load-bearing: they are the only sources that reproduce their deployments, and editing them silently breaks verification. Deployed-but-out-of-repo contracts live in their own repos and are not tracked here: UChildUSDT0 (USDT), and UChildAdministrableERC20 (USDC.e, 0xDD9185DB084f5C4fFf3b4f70E7bA62123b812226). Note that USDC.e's shell IS a UChildERC20Proxy, but compiled with solc 0.6.12 — this repo's sources are hard-pinned to 0.6.6 and cannot reproduce it, so it is a third proxy build outside the two pinned here. Neither USDC.e contract has ever been upgraded: same implementation from deployment (2020-09-27) to today.

contracts.name: RootChainManagerProxy
contracts.note: Immutable entry point of the whole root bridge; the address every integrator hardcodes. Reproduces from UpgradableProxy, which was restored to its deployed form (the zero-address check in updateImplementation and the public/memory updateAndCall signature) precisely so these shells stay verifiable — they can never be redeployed.

contracts.name: ERC20PredicateProxy
contracts.note: Holds the bridge's ERC20 float. Registered under keccak256("ERC20").

contracts.name: ChainExitERC1155PredicateProxy
contracts.note: The one proxy shell deployed with the optimizer ON — every other one has it off. Deployed later than the rest, alongside the ChainExit predicate.

contracts.name: RootChainManager (impl)
contracts.note: UPGRADEABLE impl behind RootChainManagerProxy, redeployed Aug 2025 with the token-bridging pause and the migration-manager role (broadcast/RootChainManagerUpdate.s.sol). Deployed via forge, hence runs=999999 — the older contracts here were deployed via hardhat at runs=200.

contracts.name: ERC20Predicate (impl)
contracts.note: UPGRADEABLE impl behind ERC20PredicateProxy, redeployed Aug 2025 (broadcast/ERC20PredicateUpdate.s.sol). The ONLY predicate with a real migrateTokens — which is why that function lives in IMigratableTokenPredicate rather than ITokenPredicate: putting it on the shared interface forces a stub into the other seven predicates, none of which were redeployed, and every one of them stops reproducing.

contracts.name: ChainExitERC1155Predicate (impl)
contracts.note: Deprecated and never redeployed, so it reproduces only from the sources of its own era: `exitTokens(address, address, bytes memory) public` rather than the tightened ITokenPredicate signature the other predicates carry, and RLPReaderLegacy rather than the upstream library. Both are frozen for its sake — see contracts/lib/legacy/. Upgradeable, not an immutable pin, so a redeploy would let all of that go.

contracts.name: ChildChainManagerProxy
contracts.note: Immutable entry point of the child bridge; the only address authorised to mint deposited tokens on Polygon.

contracts.name: ChildChainManager (impl)
contracts.note: Reproduces only while cleanMapToken re-emits TokenMapped, as the 2020 deployment does. The distinct TokenUnmapped event added in March 2023 (dcb6eca) moves one PUSH32 and breaks the match — which is why it lives on the branch that verifies testnet, whose Amoy implementation does have it. Upgradeable, so a redeploy on mainnet would flip which side reproduces.

contracts.name: UChildERC20Proxy (AAVE)
contracts.note: Immutable shell shared, as code, by most mapped ERC20s on Polygon: each token deploys its own instance at its own address, but they all run this runtime. AAVE is pinned as the representative for one of the two metadata groups; the DAI entry below covers the other. Verifying it once covers the whole class.

contracts.name: UChildERC20Proxy (DAI)
contracts.note: Second metadata group of the same shell (byte-identical logic to the AAVE instance, different CBOR blob — compiled from a differently-laid-out flattening). WBTC and others share this one.

contracts.name: UChildERC20 (impl, WBTC)
contracts.note: The current child-ERC20 implementation: the one with changeName(). WBTC is pinned as its representative — each mapped token deploys its own copy at its own address, but they all run this runtime, so verifying it once covers the class. UChildDAI extends this same source. Built on the frozen EIP712BaseLegacy/NativeMetaTransactionLegacy chain (see contracts/common/legacy/): the modern EIP712Base is live too, under RootChainManager, and the two cannot be merged without breaking one of them.

contracts.name: UChildERC20 (superseded, pre-changeName)
contracts.note: DOCUMENTED, NOT VERIFIED. An earlier build of the same contract, before changeName() was added — 14214 bytes against the current 14791. Still live behind AAVE, UNI, CRV, SUSHI, BAL and GHST, which were never upgraded to the current implementation. It cannot be reproduced from UChildERC20.sol at the same time as the WBTC/DAI cohort above, and freezing a second copy of the whole token just to verify a superseded build is not worth the source it would cost. Recorded here so the cohort is visible rather than silently unchecked; it drops out entirely once those six tokens are upgraded.

contracts.name: UChildDAI (impl, DAI)
contracts.note: Extends the same UChildERC20 source as the entry above and inherits its constraints wholesale: the frozen legacy EIP-712 chain and ChainConstants. UChildDAI itself carries nothing extra that pinning has to hold.
